description: "Parish Papers" by Norman Macleod is a religious treatise written in the mid-19th century. The work delves into the essence of Christianity, emphasizing the pivotal role of Jesus Christ and exploring various theological concepts, including final judgment, eternal life, and the nature of faith in Christ.
